definition: הַמְנִיכָא Qr ( Kt המינכָא , also [Gi] המוניכא , etc.) noun [masculine] chain, necklace (Talmud הַמְנִכָּא D WB 108 ; Syriac ; loan-word from Greek μανιάκης K § 64, 4 ; or < Persian hämy¹n , girdle [diminutive would be hamy¹nak ] (whence also Greek μαν ., Bev Dr Dan 5:7 ) Andr M 60* (reading הַמְיָֽנְכָא ); see also Behrm ix Lag Ges. Abh. 40; Arm. Stud. 1420 ; see Krauss 5 f. (who compares also Talmud מוּנְיָיק , מָנְיָיק necklace, bracelet , Levy NHWB iii. 52 b, 158 b D 230 )); — of gold, Dan 5:7 ; Dan 5:16 ; Dan 5:29 .
